name: Prospero Manager, Orbit Store, BlackBox, HyperHEN & RESTORE_PM

payloads.name: Orbit Store
payloads.description: PS5 game download manager with a browser-based interface
payloads.author: saawant12

payloads.name: BlackBox
payloads.description: WARNING: Developer says do not launch this ELF with Payload Manager. Install PPSA01453.ffpkg via ShadowMount instead.
payloads.author: D3ATHLY
payloads.release_notes: Developer warning: Do not launch blackbox.elf using Payload Manager. Install PPSA01453.ffpkg with ShadowMount; the ELF is bundled inside the FFPKG.

payloads.name: HyperHEN
payloads.description: All-in-one PS5 HEN, HyperCore and Toolbox. Requires a jailbroken PS5 and external elfldr; check exact firmware support before launching.
payloads.author: Michele-M-Media
payloads.release_notes: Requires a jailbroken PS5 with an external elfldr on TCP 9021. Firmware support uses exact profiles; some profiles have not been hardware-validated. Read the upstream release notes before launching.

payloads.name: RESTORE_PM
payloads.description: Restore the Payload Manager home screen icon on a jailbroken PS5 when it is missing or will not open. Does not remove other apps.
payloads.author: KINGDKAK
